item.title: see through walls
item.description:
The Problem Real-time multiplayer AR typically breaks down when participants move behind physical obstacles—walls block line-of-sight, breaking spatial awareness. Existing solutions either require expensive infrastructure or fail to maintain a shared reference frame across devices. This repo demonstrates a practical fix using MultiSet’s Visual Positioning System (VPS) to align all devices to the same 3D map, then render avatars behind walls as glowing skeletons.

item.title: MoonEP
item.description:
The Problem
Expert parallelism (EP) in Mixture-of-Experts models is fundamentally unbalanced: router output skews token loads across ranks, so some ranks receive far more than S × K tokens. This drives up iteration time (the hottest rank sets the pace) and fragments GPU memory until training OOMs. Existing libraries like DeepEP v2 suffer from both problems.
What This Does
MoonEP is a communication library for EP that guarantees every rank receives exactly S × K tokens per layer, regardless of...
